definitions.gloss: to hang; to dangle; to suspend oneself
definitions.explanation: To be suspended from something, or to hang oneself from a support.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鉄棒|てつぼう}→鉄棒：17912_tetsubou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぶら{下|さ}がる。
examples.english: To hang from a horizontal bar.

examples.japanese: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{吊|つ}り{革|かわ}→吊り革：08351_tsurikawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぶら{下|さ}がる。
examples.english: To hang onto the train strap.

examples.japanese: ⟦{木|き}→木：00524_ki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぶら{下|さ}がっている。
examples.english: Fruit is hanging from the tree branch.

notes:
ぶら{下|さ}がる describes something hanging or dangling from a support point. It can refer to objects suspended from above or people hanging from bars, straps, etc.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Pair: ⟦ぶら{下|さ}げる→ぶら下げる：10613_burasageru⟧ (transitive — to hang something)
- Pattern: X⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧[support]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぶら{下|さ}がる

ASPECT (ている):
ぶら{下|さ}がっている describes a continuing state: ⟦{果物|くだもの}→果物：00509_kudamono⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ぶら{下|さ}がっている (fruit is hanging).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{鉄棒|てつぼう}→鉄棒：17912_tetsubou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぶら{下|さ}がる (to hang from a horizontal bar)
- ⟦{吊|つ}り{革|かわ}→吊り革：08351_tsurikawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ぶら{下|さ}がる (to hang onto a train strap)
- ⟦{枝|えだ}→枝：02181_eda⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ぶら{下|さ}がる (to hang from a branch)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{吊|つ}るす→吊るす：03938_tsurusu⟧: to hang, suspend (transitive, more general)
- ⟦{垂|た}れる→垂れる：10075_tareru⟧: to droop, hang down (focus on drooping motion)
